reference.voiceDescription: An adult man in his early thirties, native Russian with clear standard Russian pronunciation and no foreign accent. A rounded lower-middle male register, smooth and grounded, with measured natural articulation. He is explaining an ordinary household arrangement to a visitor, straightforward and cooperative with mild dry amusement at the final detail. Calm conversational pauses; no formal lecture, narrator delivery or exaggerated bass.
